name: Concurrent markers and external edges
source:
stateDiagram-v2
[*] --> Active
state Active {
 [*] --> Read
 Read --> [*]
 --
 [*] --> Write
 Write --> [*]
}
Active --> Done

name: Three regions and first-last fallback
source:
stateDiagram-v2
state Parallel {
 A --> B
 --
 C --> D
 --
 E --> F
}
Ready --> Parallel
Parallel --> Done

name: Nested composite in a region
Left and right notes
source:
stateDiagram-v2
state "Review" as A
note right of A
 Keep all words
 and both lines.
end note
A --> B : next
note left of B : Save the result.

name: Fork and join
source:
stateDiagram-v2
state split <<fork>>
state merge <<join>>
[*] --> split
split --> Read
split --> Write
Read --> merge
Write --> merge
merge --> [*]

name: Choice and state descriptions
source:
stateDiagram-v2
state c <<choice>>
state "Check input" as A
A : Validate fields
[*] --> A
A --> c
c --> Yes : valid
c --> No : invalid

name: Direction comments and inert classes
source:
---
config:
 theme: dark
---
%%{init: {'theme':'forest'}}%%
stateDiagram
direction LR
classDef hot fill:red
class A, B hot
[*]:::hot --> A:::hot
A --> B %% trailing comment
B --> [*]:::hot
%% ignored --> node

name: Nested direction and composite note
source:
stateDiagram-v2
state Parent {
 direction LR
 A --> B
}
note right of Parent : Inner work
Parent --> End

name: Composite restart
Mermaid documented concurrency example
source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Active
    state Active {
        [*] --> NumLockOff
        NumLockOff --> NumLockOn : EvNumLockPressed
        NumLockOn --> NumLockOff : EvNumLockPressed
        --
        [*] --> CapsLockOff
        CapsLockOff --> CapsLockOn : EvCapsLockPressed
        CapsLockOn --> CapsLockOff : EvCapsLockPressed
        --
        [*] --> ScrollLockOff
        ScrollLockOff --> ScrollLockOn : EvScrollLockPressed
        ScrollLockOn --> ScrollLockOff : EvScrollLockPressed
    }
